upstream_contract.behavior: For a nested linked worktree, when the worktree has a prioritized context file, skip the main worktree ancestor file with the same filename. Compare canonicalized directory plus the filename, so a worktree symlink back to the main file still appears once at the worktree path.
guards: Inherit the main repo context if the worktree has none.
Do not skip a differently named context file.
Do not treat a bare worktree container, sibling worktree or submodule as a nested main-worktree duplicate.
Retain unrelated ancestors above the main repo.

new_upstream_cases: should load the worktree's context once when it symlinks to the main repo's file
should skip the main repo's duplicate when the main repo's file is a symlink
